name: Two Webs
line: An editorial diptych: the cancer web on ivory and the chronic-disease web on ink blue fill the cover side by side, one search lights matches in both and says per web when something is not on that map, and the signature moment is the hinge between the two pages sliding with the scroll (cancer widens, then chronic disease with its five grade names, then both lit for smoking) before the page opens onto the two explorers.
notes: The blue ramp for the chronic grades runs from the most visible line (Strong, nearly white) to the faintest (Weak) because it sits on ink blue; on ivory (caption legend, entry cards) it runs dark to light as directed. Conflicting links are dashed. The chronic web comes from the older skeleton file (version 1.4), so its entry cards list linked items and grades without counts and carry a one-line note that the explorer has the current grades. Both webs use the page's own force layout (springs weakened by degree, steps clamped), kept even after the shared EpiNet.layout was fixed, so the two pages match. Fraunces has no Cyrillic (Mulish does); a Russian version would need another display face. On phones the diptych stacks, cancer above chronic disease, and the hinge slides vertically.
